children: The Invesco S&P 500 Equal Weight ETF
had a 100% winning record on Sept. 11 trading days in the historical dataset, making it the standout among the major ETFs tracked by Bluekurtic Market Insights.
RSP gained an average of 0.6% on Sept. 11, with a median return of 0.5%. The SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust
was positive on 83.3% of trading days, with an average gain of 0.4% and a median gain of 0.3%.
had the lowest positive rate among the five ETFs at 66.7%, although it posted an average gain of 0.5% and a median gain of 0.6%. The iShares Russell 2000 ETF
and SPDR Dow Jones Industrial Average ETF Trust
each rose on 83.3% of Sept. 11 trading days, with average gains of 0.5%.
The historical record included several strong Sept. 11 sessions. In 2007, RSP gained 1.3%, SPY rose 1.2%, QQQ advanced 1.5%, IWM climbed 1.8%, and DIA added 1.3%.

The data covered Sept. 11 performance from 2000 through 2026, with several years marked as “Market Closed.” It also marks Sept. 11, 2026, as closed. However, Sept. 11, 2026, falls on a Friday and is not a scheduled U.S. market holiday.
